    fft_result = np.fft.rfft(x, n= num_features)

    # Apply random weights and phases in the frequency domain
    weighted_fft = frequencies * fft_result * np.exp(1j * phases[:len(fft_result)])

    # Inverse transform to get the function value
    result = np.fft.irfft(weighted_fft, n=n)
    return np.sum(result**2)
